title: Colorbond Fence quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a new 1.8m high Colorbond Fence in Monument colour for Mrs. Henderson at 14 Acacia Avenue, Sunnybank, QLD. This includes removal and disposal of approximately 25 linear metres of existing dilapidated timber fence. The new fence will be 25 linear metres, consisting of eleven (11) Colorbond fence panels (2.4m wide x 1.8m high), twelve (12) C-section steel posts (Monument, 2.4m long), twenty-two (22) top and bottom rails (Monument, 2.4m long), twelve (12) post caps, and twenty-four (24) bracket sets. Post footings will use twenty (20) bags of 20kg pre-mix concrete. Also includes one (1) 900mm wide x 1.8m high pedestrian gate in Monument, complete with gate frame, heavy-duty hinges, and a D-latch and striker.
workingDetail: Colorbond fence sheets, Steel posts (C-section), Top and bottom rails, Post caps and brackets
